<style>

#title-block-header {
  display: none;
}

.about-page {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Three main sections */

.about-section {
  padding: 2.75rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
}

.about-section:first-child {
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
}

.about-section:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.about-section h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  font-size: 1.65rem;
}

/* Text and image layout */

.section-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(240px, 0.8fr);
  gap: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.section-row.reverse {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(240px, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.35fr);
}

.about-section p {
  line-height: 1.75;
}

/* Images */

.section-photo {
  display: block;
  width: 82%;
  max-width: 280px;
  height: auto;
  max-height: 300px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.section-photo + .section-photo {
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.image-caption {
  max-width: 280px;
  margin: 0.65rem auto 0;
  color: #777777;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Endurance event list */

.event-list {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
}

.event-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
}

.event-year {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.event-name {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* WeChat QR code */

.wechat-qr {
  display: block;
  width: 220px;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0 auto;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* Mobile layout */

@media (max-width: 768px) {

  .about-section {
    padding: 2rem 0;
  }

  .section-row,
  .section-row.reverse {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .section-row.reverse .section-image-column {
    order: 2;
  }

  .event-item {
    grid-template-columns: 55px 1fr;
  }

}

</style>

## Travel

I enjoy traveling and driving. So far, I have visited **40 U.S. states**. Each journey has given me opportunities to experience different cities and cultures, meeting new people, and creating unforgettable memories.

</div>

## Playing

I enjoy different racket sports, especially **table tennis, badminton, and tennis**. I started playing table tennis at a young age. During college, I was a member of both the university **table tennis team** and **badminton team**. They require quick reactions, but also patience and concentration.

## Endurance

I also enjoy running and swimming. Over the years, I have completed several running and triathlon events. They gave me a different kind of feeling when I build endurance, consistency, and the ability to continue moving forward.

## Writing

I also enjoy writing. During my travels, I document my journeys on my personal WeChat Official Account, **行囊中的梦** (*Dreams in My Backpack*). It is part travel diary and part photo wall, the people I have met, and the moments I want to remember.

If you are interested, you can scan the QR code to follow the account and browse my travel notes.
